description: The bullet chart for review meetings. Put Actual next to Target, Forecast and Prior year and see at a glance which lines are on target, by how much, and whether you will make the year. Bands, status and variance are computed in the visual - no DAX - and premium adds a summary sentence that says what the chart shows. Free features: Actual vs Target for unlimited rows, horizontal or vertical, or as KPI tiles Bands from % of target (80/100 by default) or from your own measures, plus an optional stretch band Lower-is-better KPIs (costs, scrap, lead time): bands, colours and variance flip, for the whole visual or per row Status icons with distinct shapes, so status never depends on colour alone Data labels: variance (absolute and %), target labels and category labels, plus a variance bar; shared axis with grid lines, display units and decimals Target marker as a line, full-height line, line with arrows or triangle Legend that names Actual, Target, Forecast, Prior year, bands and pace markers by your measure names, with top or bottom position Small multiples: group sections or side-by-side group panels with an on-target count per group IBCS notation: AC and PL labels with absolute and relative variance columns Sort worst first, best first or by largest gap; Top N with Others Per-row units or format strings from a measure (Unit or format field) for mixed-unit scorecards: 96.1%, 12.6…
